Let \(G\in\mathcal F\). Since \(G\) is positive semidefinite with diagonal entries \(1\), all entries are bounded, so \(\mathcal F\) is compact and a determinant maximum exists.

The constraints are invariant under cyclic relabeling of the indices. If \(P\) is the cyclic permutation matrix, then
\[
\overline G=\frac16\sum_{k=0}^5 P^kG(P^k)^T
\]
also lies in \(\mathcal F\), is symmetric circulant, and has determinant at least that of \(G\) by concavity of \(\log\det\) on positive definite matrices. The eventual maximizer below is positive definite, so the maximum determinant is positive; hence any maximizer is positive definite. Strict concavity then forces equality only when \(G\) itself is cyclically invariant. Thus the unique maximizer, if found among the circulant matrices, is the unique maximizer in all of \(\mathcal F\).

For
\[
C(a,b)=\operatorname{circ}\left(1,\frac12,a,b,a,\frac12\right),
\]
the eigenvalues are
\[
\lambda_0=2+2a+b,\qquad
\lambda_1=\lambda_5=\frac32-a-b,
\]
\[
\lambda_2=\lambda_4=\frac12-a+b,\qquad
\lambda_3=2a-b.
\]
Write
\[
x=\lambda_0,\quad u=\lambda_1,\quad v=\lambda_2,\quad y=\lambda_3.
\]
The trace and fixed adjacent entry give
\[
x+y+2u+2v=6,\qquad x-y+u-v=3,
\]
and
\[
\det C=xyu^2v^2.
\]
At the interior maximum, Lagrange multipliers for
\[
\log x+\log y+2\log u+2\log v
\]
give
\[
\frac1x=\mu+\nu,\quad \frac1y=\mu-\nu,\quad
\frac2u=2\mu+\nu,\quad \frac2v=2\mu-\nu.
\]
Let \(t=y/x\). Eliminating the multipliers from the two linear constraints gives
\[
\frac1t-3-\frac{16}{t+3}=0,
\]
so
\[
t^2+8t-1=0,\qquad t=\sqrt{17}-4.
\]
Substituting back yields
\[
x=\frac{\sqrt{17}+7}{4},\qquad
y=\frac{3\sqrt{17}-11}{4},\qquad
u=1,\qquad
v=\frac{5-\sqrt{17}}2.
\]
These are all positive, so the maximum is attained in the positive definite interior.

Now recover \(a,b\) from the inverse Fourier relations:
\[
a=\frac{x+y-u-v}{6}=\frac{\sqrt{17}-3}{4},
\]
\[
b=\frac{x-y-2u+2v}{6}=\frac{5-\sqrt{17}}{4}.
\]
Finally,
\[
D=xyu^2v^2
=\frac{\sqrt{17}+7}{4}\cdot \frac{3\sqrt{17}-11}{4}\cdot \left(\frac{5-\sqrt{17}}2\right)^2
=\frac{85\sqrt{17}-349}{8}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\left(\frac{85\sqrt{17}-349}{8},\frac{\sqrt{17}-3}{4},\frac{5-\sqrt{17}}{4}\right)}
\]
